body.title: Make repository and indexing fixtures honor current contracts
body.reproduction: repo-completeness expects a seeded repository to be complete but receives unembedded:4. Search-filter/guard tests wait 180 seconds without observing the expected indexing refusal. Analyze-step fixtures hardcode a deprecated insrc-ide path and then pass undefined state tokens after start fails. MCP pass-through compares /private/var/folders with /var/folders for the same repository.
body.rootCause: The seeded helper writes low-level Lance vectors after empty-embedding entity upserts, bypassing the graph embedding markers now used for completeness. Other fixtures assume a particular checkout and noncanonical temporary path. The exact reason the indexing window is missed remains unverified and must be diagnosed with a deterministic fixture rather than guessed.
body.fixIntent: Make repository fixtures isolated, explicitly registered, embedding-marker consistent and path-canonical across in-process and MCP use; make the indexing-state tests deterministically reach the state they claim to test. Acceptance: completeness positive controls are actually complete, indexing refusal/filter assertions run during a verified index, analyzer continuation uses a valid returned token, and MCP prompt comparisons agree without deprecated-fork dependencies. Do not relax production scoping or fabricate completeness.
